newspaper.headline: Kelabu Group Targets Finance Teams
newspaper.lead: A hacker group calling itself Kelabu is said to be planning a multi-step attack on companies in the Nusantara area. SOC teams at many offices have been asked to stay alert from the morning.

impact.good: Yesterday, harmful files disguised as delivery receipts were stopped before anyone opened them. No office laptops were infected.
impact.mixed: Yesterday, most harmful files were stopped, but a few got through and are being checked again.
impact.bad: Yesterday, several harmful files were opened on office laptops. The affected devices are being quarantined.

tip.title: Tip: Contain First, Then Clean Up
tip.text: When an incident happens, stop it from spreading first, for example by isolating a device or changing a password. After that, clean up, recover, and report.

sources: NIST SP 800-61: Computer Security Incident Handling Guide
